name: Cardiff and Vale IAS — adult autism diagnostic assessments
description: Local NHS Wales Integrated Autism Service information covering adult autism referral, triage, diagnostic assessment and review of private diagnostic reports in Cardiff and the Vale of Glamorgan.
intended_use: Inspect a current local Wales adult autism pathway, including self-referral and private-report requirements, while keeping it explicitly local rather than Wales-wide.
audience_or_context: Adults living in the Cardiff and Vale University Health Board area who are considering autism assessment, and people supporting them.
limitations: This is a Cardiff and Vale University Health Board pathway, not a Wales-wide referral rule.
Waiting-time figures and service eligibility can change and require local rechecking.
Private autism diagnoses are reviewed against the service's stated requirements; this does not establish acceptance by every Welsh NHS service.
cost_or_access_notes: The NHS service is locally commissioned; access depends on current catchment and eligibility. The page describes separate private-report review but does not recommend private providers.
conflicts_of_interest: Cardiff and Vale University Health Board describes a service it provides; ND Oracle records its current access route without generalising its performance or rules to Wales as a whole.

provenance.method: Current Cardiff and Vale IAS diagnostic-assessment page checked on 2026-09-03 for referral, triage, assessment and private-report wording. Listing is local, descriptive and claimless.
